name: collapsible
useFor: Use to hide secondary detail under a row (more card settings, a purchase's line items). Put a CollapsibleTrigger (often asChild on a button) and CollapsibleContent inside Collapsible; control it with open and onOpenChange when needed.
constraints: A trigger without a visible state
title: Collapsible
description: A disclosure that grows open and shut with the brand's 300ms ease-out.
